主要内容: On June 8, 2012, The Walt Disney Company entered into a new $2.25 billion Five-Year Credit Agreement with a syndicate of lenders to support commercial paper borrowings and for other general corporate purposes. This new facility will expire in June 2017 and replaces the Registrant’s $2.29 billion Three-Year Credit Agreement, which was scheduled to expire on February 22, 2013. The agreement allows borrowing at LIBOR-based rates plus a spread, subject to a cap and floor tied to its debt rating. The new facility includes one financial covenant related to interest coverage and excludes entities like Euro Disney, Hong Kong Disneyland, and Shanghai Disney Resort from certain obligations. The agreement is filed as Exhibit 10.1.
